{{Quote|The shipyards of Kuat are famous throughout the galaxy. Here, the Republic's ''Acclamator'' assault ships and the Empire's Star Destroyers were built. A vast man-made ring of factories and spacedocks encircles the planet, allowing huge vessels to be built in orbit.|The ''[[Galactic Atlas]]''|<ref name="SWGA">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref>}}
The '''Kuat shipyards''',<ref name="Twilight Company" /> also dubbed '''Kuat Drive Yards''' after their custodian company,<ref name="BMF 27">{{BuildFalconCite|27|Starship Fact File}}</ref> consisted of a massive [[space station]] which encircled<ref name="Blade Squadron: Kuat">{{InsiderCite|168|Blade Squadron: Kuat}}</ref> the [[Core Worlds|Core]]<ref name="TFA Visual Dictionary" /> [[planet]] [[Kuat]], utilized by [[Kuat Drive Yards]]. After the [[Proclamation of the New Order|founding]] of the [[Galactic Empire]],<ref name="ROUVG">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> in [[19 BBY]]<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> the [[shipyard]]s were converted from civilian shipyards to the manufacture of [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]]<ref name="ROUVG" /> and all manner of vehicles for the Galactic Empire.<ref name="Twilight Company" /> Around [[17 BBY]],<ref name="17BBYDN">''[[Battlefront II: Inferno Squad]]'' establishes that [[Gideon Hask]] was orphaned at age of ten by the [[bombing at the Kuat shipyards]]. The novel also establishes Gideon Hask is twenty-seven [[Standard year|years]] old. As this is mentioned three [[Standard day|days]] after the [[Battle of Yavin]], which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[0 ABY]], it places Hask's [[Reproduction|birth]] around [[27 BBY]]. Therefore, the bombing must have occurred around [[17 BBY]].</ref> the shipyards were the site of a [[Bombing at the Kuat shipyards|bombing]] organized by a [[Unidentified rebel infiltrator|rebel infiltrator]], who planted and detonated an [[Bomb|explosive]], creating a blast that killed the ten year old [[Gideon Hask]]'s parents. Afterward, Hask was left an orphan.<ref name="Inferno Squad" />

[[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel]] agents were located near the Kuat Shipyards and gave reports to [[General]] [[Airen Cracken]] about their findings.<ref name="Rebel Files" /> The Alliance carried out a [[Bombing of the Kuat shipyards|bombing run]] against the Kuat shipywards in the aftermath of the [[Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="Star Wars 4" /> In [[5 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' states that the battle for [[Kuat Drive Yards]] took place twenty-four [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[19 BBY]]. Therefore, the battle must have taken place in [[5 ABY]].</ref> the [[New Republic]], the successor state of the Rebel Alliance, [[Defense of Kuat|attacked]] the shipyards once again. The battle ended with a surrender from the Empire, and the shipyards were taken.<ref name="Life Debt" />
